enrichment-abilities.json.name: Their Number is Legion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time this unit's Reanimation Protocols activate, re-roll the dice determining how many wounds are reanimated.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Engrammatic Logic
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer selects one friendly NECRONS unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12", and that unit is no longer Battle-shocked. Battle-shock remains implicit in remove-battle-shock; full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Necrodermis
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: defensive: -1 to incoming damage (floored at 1 by the engine)

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Infectious Murder-Madness (Aura)
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Aura (6"): a friendly NECRONS unit (excluding MONSTER and TITANIC) within range grants each of its attacks [SUSTAINED HITS 1] when the attacking model is DESTROYER CULT. The rules text's alternate OR-branch (an attack into the closest eligible target also qualifies) is a per-attack, per-target gate the schema has no leaf for and is not modeled here; only the DESTROYER CULT keyword branch is represented.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Tectonic Reverberations
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Selection is restricted to an enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model; that 18"/visibility restriction is not encoded, and the mark's until-your-next-Movement-phase window is modeled as one battle round. Pinned debuff (−2 Move, −2 to Charge rolls) mirrors the grav-pinned encoding. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Obelisk Node Control
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] While the bearer is within range of an objective marker it controls, the enemy Reserves-setup exclusion zone around it is pushed out to 12"; the proximity and control conditions are modeled as an AND of two predicates rather than bound to the same objective marker ([APPROX] same-objective binding).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hypermotility Protocols
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies per-unit to friendly Immortals and Necron Warriors: their ranged weapons gain [Assault], and being selected to Advance does not stop them starting an Action. The detachment's DYNASTY tag / mutual-exclusion is list-construction metadata, not modeled as an effect here.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Transdimensional Deployment
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to friendly TOMB BLADES units: they gain Deep Strike, and their ranged attacks get +1 to Hit in a turn they made an ingress (Deep Strike) move.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Empowered Engines
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units: +6" Move.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Recursive Reanimation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: TOMB BLADES enhancement: add 1 to the roll when the bearer's unit activates its Reanimation Protocols.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Subsurface Quantumweave
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Reactive defensive stratagem used when an enemy unit targets a friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase: attacks that target your unit have Armour Penetration 1 until that enemy unit has finished attacking. Modeled as setting attacker AP to 1; the scoping to only the triggering enemy unit and the 'until it has attacked' window are not fully encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Prelocational Optimiser
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Applies only when the bearer's unit was set up this turn using a Monolith's Eternity Gate ability; when it is then selected to shoot, its ranged attacks gain either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. The Eternity-Gate deployment precondition is not expressible in the condition set. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Technosorcerous Augmentations
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Detachment rule: CRYPTEK ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; additionally, each time a CRYPTEK unit is selected to shoot, one listed weapon ability may be chosen for its ranged weapons until end of phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Relentless Onslaught
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] +1 to Hit applies to NECRONS attacks (excluding MONSTER models) targeting a unit within range of an objective marker; the [ASSAULT] grant applies only to NECRONS VEHICLE and MOUNTED (excluding TITANIC) ranged weapons. Those keyword restrictions are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Cold Fervour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Step 1 (+2 Strength to DESTROYER CULT weapons) is always on. Step 2 fires the first time each turn a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys an enemy unit or brackets it below half-strength, granting +2 Strength to other friendly NECRONS weapons (excluding DESTROYER CULT/MONSTER/TITANIC) until end of turn; the kill trigger, the keyword exclusions, and the until-end-of-turn window are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Annihilation Protocol
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Charge re-roll and the +1 Charge (when a charge target is Below Half-strength) apply to DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES units; the +1 Armour Penetration applies only to DESTROYER CULT ranged attacks that target the closest eligible target. The per-keyword scoping and the closest-target restriction are not encoded, and unit-below-half-strength approximates the target being below half. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hyperphasing
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] At the end of your opponent's turn, remove the selected NECRONS units to Strategic Reserves. The maximum selectable scales with battle size (Incursion 1 / Strike Force 2 / Onslaught 3) and is encoded at the Onslaught cap of 3; the end-of-opponent's-turn timing and the exclusion of units within Engagement Range are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Cosmic Distortion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Grants NECRONS MONSTER units the Distortion Fields aura: an enemy unit within 6" is 'unravelling', so attacks targeting it improve Armour Penetration by 1. The optional 3-mortal-wound extension of the aura to 9" and the model-specific C'tan binding abilities in the store text are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Worthy Foes
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Detachment rule: in your Command phase mark one enemy unit; friendly NOBLE, LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH units add 1 to Wound rolls against it until the start of your next Command phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Power Matrix
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The named region permanently starts as the army's deployment zone, with each other zone added for a phase only after the army controls at least half of that zone's objective markers at phase start. Eligible CRYPTEK and CANOPTEK units re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or re-roll the Hit roll instead while wholly within the region.
